equivalent.name: K13-5 wait-ended selection without explicit mandatory-first priority (sort the correct union, truncate)
equivalent.argument: Equivalent on reachable states (design 01 addendum 01 § A1, design check 01 D01-CHK-01): W-2 tests the queued backlog before it mints a timeout at registration, and an eligible arrival retires a live wait in its own ingress decision before any fire, so every eligible candidate beside a real timeout was accepted after it; for an Event wake the mandatory member is by definition the earliest eligible candidate. The five examples cannot kill it; waits-selection.test.ts asserts it passes all five and checks the literal rule on one synthetic selector input.
